listing.name: PatrolsGoAway ( avoid stronger player fleet while transponder is off )
listing.summary: I always found tiny friendly patrol rushing to your huge fleet to ask about transponder very annoying and unrealistic. They shouldn't know who you are thus they should avoid you like you are a pirate.
listing.aiSummary: Makes friendly patrols avoid the player's fleet when it is significantly stronger and the transponder is off.

description:
I always found tiny friendly patrol rushing to your huge fleet to ask about transponder very annoying and unrealistic. They shouldn't know who you are thus they should avoid you like you are a pirate.

With this mod, if your forces are 1.5x stronger than friendly patrols, they will avoid you but prevent docking when spotted.

Don't confuse this with vanilla hostile patrol behavior, they already avoid you when you are stronger, this mod makes friendly patrols avoid too while transponder is off.

AI warning: Fully made by deepseek llm 4.1.

Drop into your mods folder, enable it and enjoy. there is no compiled parts so you can read/edit everything with text editor.

https://github.com/alp7292/PatrolsGoAway/archive/refs/heads/main.zip
